domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with regrouping and simplification

skills.name: Prepare operands for subtraction
skills.definition: Set up the numbers in subtraction-ready form by rewriting operands as needed and establishing compatible fractional parts, including common-denominator conversion when required.
skills.merge_rationale: This merges the two preparation skills because both are setup operations that occur before core subtraction and serve the same instructional phase: making operands compatible for subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract and regroup
skills.definition: Compute the difference by subtracting aligned whole and fractional parts and regrouping by borrowing when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
skills.merge_rationale: Retained as a merged execution cluster because subtraction and borrowing form a single computational phase; borrowing is a conditional extension of subtraction rather than an independent phase.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms or convert zero-valued fractional forms into 0 or an equivalent integer form when appropriate.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate at K=4 to preserve the distinction between numerical reduction and answer formatting; students may simplify incorrectly even when they can express the answer form.

skills.name: Express final answer
skills.definition: Present the final value in standard form as an appropriate mixed number, fraction, or integer after computation.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate at K=4 to preserve the representational final step, which can vary independently from simplification and remains instructionally meaningful.
